Package org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker

Class ChartDef

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.freemarker.ChartDef
public final class ChartDef extends Object
Typed builder for a chart card.

Produces the same contract entry as <@card type="chart">; PageSpec runs it through ChartCardType when the page renders. The factories are line(String), bar(String), donut(String), heatmap(String), scatter(String), pie(String), treemap(String) and raw(String). line, bar and donut emit the flat legacy form (kind:"line", x:..., series:[...]) byte-for-byte; the other kinds emit helper:{kind, ...}, and raw emits neither (its option(JsonMap) is the whole chart).

Example:

page.card(ChartDef.line("orders-trend").title("Orders").src("/console/store/stats/daily") .x("day").series("placed", "Placed").series("delivered", "Delivered").toCardSpec());

Since:
10.0.0

    • treemap

      public static ChartDef treemap(String id)
      A treemap: rows nested into boxes by groupBy(String...), one tile per row, with pan and zoom.

      A click on a tile publishes the row's tileFields(String...) as meta (the tile's row is always null); a click on a group does nothing.

      Example:

      ChartDef.treemap("fleet").src("/api/hosts").groupBy("region", "cluster").label("host") .colorBy("health", ChartDef.legendItem("ok", "Healthy", "ok"), ChartDef.legendItem("down", "Down", "danger")) .tileFields("host", "health");

      Parameters:
      id - The card id.
      Returns:
      A new treemap; set its groups with groupBy(String...) and its tile label with label(String).

    • raw

      public static ChartDef raw(String id)
      A chart with no helper. Anything ECharts draws works this way, for example a box plot:

      ChartDef.raw("latency").src("/stats/latency") .option("{xAxis:{type:'category'},yAxis:{},series:[{type:'boxplot',encode:{x:'day',y:['lo','q1','med','q3','hi']}}]}");

      Parameters:
      id - The card id.
      Returns:
      A new chart with no helper; set its ECharts option with option(JsonMap).

    • onClickAction

      public ChartDef onClickAction(RowAction action)
      Runs a row action when a mark is clicked.

      A treemap tile runs it; clicking a treemap group header only zooms and runs nothing.

      Declares on("click", "<id>.click") unless a click topic is already declared, and runs action whenever that topic fires. Exclusive with onClickHref(String). The action is refused unless it has an endpoint (and, if set, a form) that is a same-origin path, a non-safe method, and no present other than dialog, and does not navigate on success.

      Parameters:
      action - The action; its id must be unique across the card's actions.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the action is not valid on a chart, onClickHref(String) was set, or no click topic can be derived: the id must match [a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}, or call on(String, String) with "click" first.

    • onTopicAction

      public ChartDef onTopicAction(String topic, RowAction action)
      Runs a row action when a topic this card publishes fires.

      Only a click has a keyboard equivalent (Enter on the focused point synthesizes a click); an action bound to another event, such as dblclick, is reachable by pointer only. A treemap group node publishes no events.

      Parameters:
      topic - A topic declared through on(String, String).
      action - The action; its id must be unique across the card's actions.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the topic is not declared, or the action is not valid on a chart.

    • actions

      public ChartDef actions(RowAction... actions)
      Adds dialog actions that other actions can open as steps.

      Each entry must have present set to dialog, and obeys the same rules as onClickAction(RowAction). Calls accumulate.

      Parameters:
      actions - The actions; ids must be unique across the card's actions.
      Returns:
      This object.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If an entry is null, is not a dialog action, or is not valid on a chart.
